items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee initially mentions 'Fred' who hired him, but when the interviewer clarifies 'Fred Anderson?', the interviewee corrects him: 'No... His name was Frederico. He was a Cuban...'

ctx.x: Yeah, at St. Luke Hospital. It was right down the street from where Fred Anderson has his place now, right down around, oh, I would say, 23rd [Street] and Indiana [Avenue].
Because, you know, you can order birth certificates here in Chicago, but if the birth certificate’s wrong.
